about_the_game:
The game is set against the backdrop of Autumn Hunting by Yuan People, a painting from over 700 years ago, now featuring 200 meticulously drawn cats. These cats create amusing interactions with the ancient scenes and characters, blending history with playful surprises.

Autumn Hunting by Yuan People is a grand handscroll painting measuring 59 cm × 1240 cm. It vividly depicts a Yuan dynasty emperor leading a hunting expedition, camping, and feasting. The composition is epic in scale, capturing historical grandeur. The characters are intricately portrayed, with facial features reflecting the distinct traits of Mongolian nobility. Notably, the scene of the crown prince and warriors galloping on horseback while hunting deer carries deep symbolic meaning.

Game Features

  • Enjoy a relaxing experience while admiring an ancient masterpiece.

  • Over 100 uniquely designed cats hidden in the artwork.

  • Soothing traditional Chinese music.

  • Cute and delightful cat sound effects.

  • 100 beautifully crafted achievement icons.

Gameplay Tips

  • Click the cover logo to view the high-resolution original painting Autumn Hunting by Yuan People.

  • Press the ESC key to hide or show in-game buttons.

  • Click the hint button to quickly locate one hidden cat in the scene (usable once every 60 seconds).
